completion_basis: The complete individual edition is publicly preserved on GitHub, Zenodo, and the authorized reader-first Figshare lineage. GitHub main, annotated tag, release metadata, and all three release assets pass anonymous readback; Zenodo and Figshare public-byte gates also pass.
source_finding_policy: Release-owned unresolved P1/P2 defects are zero. The 163 open_recorded P1/P2 ledger entries are confined to pinned upstream/source scopes; they remain visible as backend correction records rather than silently changing the source mathematics.

required_prepublication_checks.requirement: Freeze the QA-passing final reader artifact and bind its exact identity.
Bind the exact final build manifest.
Close language, mathematics, build, visual, provenance, and rights gates with no unresolved P1/P2 defect.
Create and validate the reproducible source/backend package before recording its inventory or checksums.
Include the applicable license texts, modification notice, component-rights ledger, and Heun provenance receipt in the final package.
Resolve the authorized GitHub owner and create or adopt exactly one matching downstream repository before adding downstream URLs.

required_publication_transactions.requirement: Publish tag v3.0-id.1 and one GitHub release with the exact finalized assets.
Publish one initial Zenodo book record and capture its generated concept DOI and version DOI; do not create a duplicate lineage.

required_postpublication_checks.requirement: Anonymously read back every public release artifact and prove filename, byte count, and SHA-256 identity.
Read back GitHub and Zenodo metadata and verify repository, tag, release, version, concept DOI, version DOI, rights, and related identifiers.
required_postpublication_checks.evidence: GitHub repository, main branch, annotated tag, release metadata, and all three release assets pass anonymous readback; Zenodo metadata and every public byte also pass anonymous readback.

required_postpublication_checks.requirement: Finalize the central-hub handoff using only the public identifiers and verified artifact evidence.
